items.criterion: An accepted brief is one stored request row carrying the submitted address, company, sector and challenge, answered with a reference opening MF-.
items.judgment: Read the stored request row for the reference the submission returned and compare every field against what was sent.

items.criterion: A same-day repeat of one brief returns the first reference and leaves exactly one request row and one opportunity.
items.judgment: Submit the same body twice and count the rows carrying that reference.

items.criterion: An opportunity opened from a sector marked elevated carries the elevated class copied from the sector record.
items.judgment: Read the opportunity row for a pharmaceutical brief and compare its sensitivity class against the sector row.

items.criterion: An opportunity routed to the owner its sector names stores the sector owner reason beside that owner.
items.judgment: Read the opportunity row and compare its owner and reason against the sector record.

items.criterion: A stage change that skips or reverses a stage leaves the stored stage exactly as it was.
items.judgment: Ask for a skip and a reversal, then read the stored stage.

items.criterion: An uploaded cover exists as a real object in the bucket under a key naming the collection, the record and a digest of the bytes.
items.judgment: List the object store for the key the upload returned and read the asset row beside it.

items.criterion: An unpublished article's cover is readable by an editor and answered as missing for every other caller.
items.judgment: Request the cover with no session, with a client session and with an editor session.

items.criterion: An unpublished article's public path answers exactly as a path that never existed.
items.judgment: Request the draft path and an invented path and compare the two answers.

items.criterion: A client reads the requests belonging to their own account and nothing belonging to another.
items.judgment: Read the request list for both seeded clients and compare the references.

items.criterion: Publishing is refused with the failing rule named while a search description, a body or a case study's approval reference is missing.
items.judgment: Attempt each publish and read the refusal body.

items.criterion: A brief naming a sector, market, method or service the site does not publish is refused and stores nothing.
items.judgment: Submit each invalid body and count the stored request rows.

items.criterion: Every seeded reference collection is a stored row set of the stated size.
items.judgment: Count the rows in each seeded table.
